suite.name: SCG Latency Suite
suite.description: Measures per-message processing latency through the SCG using PACED sub-saturation senders (periodic, 2000 msg/s). Latency must be measured below saturation: an unthrottled sender fills the buffers and reports bufferbloat, not the gateway's real latency. Captures handshake (connection-establishment) time per scenario.
suite.author: SESHAT
